prose: Bloomberg reports that competitive pressure to back promising AI startups is upending the venture-capital process, with investors willing to buy into the same round at rapidly escalating valuations. The fight to invest in AI startup Emulate, driving its valuation into the billions, is cited as emblematic of the frenzy.
highlights: AI startup competition is breaking normal VC process, per Bloomberg
Investors are buying into the same rounds at rapidly escalating valuations
Emulate's valuation climbing into the billions is the cited example
